name: Knots Landing
overview: The domestic adventures, misdeeds and everyday interactions of five families living on a cul-de-sac in a small California community.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a seaside suburban paradise, four married couples struggle with the conflicts and passions that buffet every marriage.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Adultery, rape and white-collar crime plague the families of seaside Knots Landing--with lethal consequences.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Passions escalate as four couples battle temptation in a seaside suburban paradise.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Lust, alcoholism and murder strike, causing further turmoil in the suburban cul-de-sac.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: William Devane joins the cast as the residents of Knots landing cope with a corrupt land-development deal, adultery, unwanted pregnancy and a Central American civil war.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Alec Baldwin joins the cast. Control of the Ewing fortune rests on the fate of illegitimate twin babies--and the residents of Knots Landing resort to blackmail, kidnapping and murder.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: The residents of an idyllic seaside cul-de-sac face an ongoing feud over a corrupt land development deal and the supposed suicide of one of them. Ava Gardner joins the cast.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: Power struggles over politics, money and sex rock the idyllic seaside community of Knots Landing.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: From the discovery of a body buried in concrete to gun-running and murder over sexual jealousy, multiple crises shatter the peace in the cul-de-sac.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Financial schemes, intrigue, murder and lust culminate in the possible expulsion from the cul-de-sac of one of the neighbors.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: Love and new relationships interweave with insidious plots, adultery and death as a serial murderer insinuates himself among the residents of the cul-de-sac.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: As two residents of the cul-de-sac confront mortality, the others living in Knots Landing continue to plot and scheme--and face surprising reversals of fortune.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: Passion, sex and violence buffet the small, seaside community of Knots Landing.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: After fourteen years of lust, greed and betrayal, passions explode in this final season of "Knots Landing."
